details.further_information: Because Hwang entered the game and won a gold medal in 2018 Asian Games, he received military privileges. 2017 Asia's Youth Player of the Year. When moving from Salzburg to Leipzig, the basic fee is 9 million euros, with bonuses the transfer fee can increase to 14 million euros. By moving from Leipzig to Wolverhampton, Salzburg will receive another three million as a resale share. The transfer fee is now a total of 12 instead of 9 million as before.
